project.name: Autonomous Space Debris Monitoring & Capturing System

spacecraft.storage_note: Subject to cumulative captured mass and available containment volume.

hold.label: HOLD
hold.description: Maintain surveillance while capture conditions remain outside operational limits.
hold.rationale: Relative motion remains unsuitable for capture authorization.

abort.label: ABORT
abort.description: Terminate proximity operations and return the spacecraft to a safe operational state.
abort.rationale: Target separation has entered an unsafe proximity condition.

small.label: PROCEED — SMALL OBJECT
small.description: Authorize precision capture using the dual side-arm gripper mechanism.
small.rationale: Target geometry is compatible with precision side-arm gripper capture.

large.label: PROCEED — LARGE OBJECT
large.description: Authorize central deployable-net capture for a large or irregular debris object.
large.rationale: Target geometry favors central deployable-net capture.

multiple.label: PROCEED — MULTIPLE OBJECTS
multiple.description: Authorize grouped-object containment using the central deployable-net capture mechanism.
multiple.rationale: Grouped debris objects are compatible with deployable-net containment.
